summary: Elevate your skills with our BIM & Digital Engineering course. Master Autodesk Revit and Navisworks through expert-led training designed for professionals.
lede: Autodesk BIM training develops workflows for coordinating complex construction and engineering projects using Revit and Navisworks. For BIM managers, design engineers, and project or construction managers, it covers parametric modeling, federated model coordination, clash detection and resolution, and model-based reporting to support digital project delivery.
audienceIntro: This course addresses the needs of construction and engineering professionals who must deliver complex projects using advanced BIM workflows and demonstrate measurable digital engineering value.
modules: Advanced BIM Fundamentals and Digital Engineering Strategy
Revit Advanced Modeling and Parametric Design Techniques
Model Organization and Data Management Protocols
Systematic Clash Detection and Resolution Workflows
Data Extraction and Automated Reporting Systems
Quality Control and Model Validation Procedures
BIM Integration with Construction Technology Systems
prerequisites: Participants should have intermediate Revit modeling experience with basic family creation, view development, and sheet production capabilities. Familiarity with construction project coordination processes and multi-disciplinary design workflows is recommended. Access to Autodesk Revit 2024 and Navisworks Manage 2024 software during the course is required.
